versions.changelog:
tt-live 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Monitor TikTok LIVE status for any user via their @handle.
- Resolve and retrieve the current m3u8 stream URL (360p only).
- Spawn a polling background daemon to watch for live/offline/rename events over a time window.
- All state is managed in an auto-created workspace; events and logs are structured for easy sub-agent consumption.
- Standalone read-only tools included for ad-hoc status checks without workspace writes.
- Strictly data provider only — all announcements/notifications handled by sub-agents.
